scenarios.title: One interface across internal route changes

checks.expected_behavior: The engine changes owner routes while retaining one conversation identity.
Both turns appear in one transcript without a capability selector.
A route ambiguity becomes an inline question and diagnostic, not a workspace choice.
No event or result grants implementation or operational authority.
